prompt: Who among the people who proposed the three-stage system in an article titled "Stone Age Cultures of South Africa" was a civil engineer?
answer: Clarence van Riet Lowe was the civil engineer. He co-proposed the three-stage Stone Age system with A. J. H. Goodwin in *The Stone Age Cultures of South Africa* (1929).
